adequacy_evidence.quote: **Scientific adequacy: qualified.** The delivered group analysis supports its reported lack of whole-brain-corrected vmPFC evidence, but the conclusion remains conditional on the zero-as-coverage mask and sign-symmetry assumptions; the report should make the former explicit as a limitation.

hypothesis_conclusion.quote: the available participant maps do not support a positive vmPFC gain effect under whole-brain family-wise error (FWE) correction.
